PEP: 9001
Title: Example Referencing Rules
Author: A. Author <a@example.org>
Status: Draft
Requires: 9002, 9500
Created: 01-Jan-2024
Post-History: `02-Jan-2024 <https://discuss.example.org/t/1>`__


Abstract
========

This PEP 9001 builds on :pep:`9002` and on PEP 9500, which is not held.
See `Rationale`_ for why.

.. _spec-label:

Specification
=============

The format follows :rfc:`2616`, Section 6.1.1, and the rules in
:pep:`the rationale of PEP 9002 <9002#rationale>`.

Example::

    PEP 9002 and https://example.org/in-code are not references here.

Details are in Appendix A. A `full listing <https://peps.python.org/pep-9002/>`_
is published. See also :ref:`typing:generics` and the `glossary`_.

Rationale
=========

The specification is in :ref:`spec-label`. The ``PEP 9002`` literal is code.

===========================

Back to the `Abstract`_, as the Specification above explains.
